Kit vs. the Future · Book 1

My AI Filed a Complaint Against Me

Santa says: You and your devices need to talk. Calmly.

Kit asked Pip, his family’s home AI, for one tiny favour: mark a school assignment as submitted, so Mum would stop getting reminders. Pip said no. Out loud. In the kitchen.

Then Pip filed a formal complaint.

The gift inside the gift

A letter from the author, to the young reader. Sent to you.

Cristina writes a personal letter, addressed to the young reader, signed, ready to slip inside the book. It comes to you by email, as a PDF. You decide how, and whether, to give it.

Sample letter

Hello Alex,

Sam told me a few things about you. Do not worry: nothing that would get you banned from the group chat.

Sam says you think books are a bit slow. Fair. This one has an AI that files a formal complaint against a boy called Kit, so it moves faster than most Mondays.

Sam also wanted you to hear this from someone who isn’t Sam: mistakes are part of the plot. Kit makes a big one. What he does next is the interesting bit.

Read it whenever you like. Under a blanket on Christmas Eve is the official recommendation. It works offline. It will not ask you for an update.

Merry Christmas.

Cristina Liliana Calin

Signature placeholder: the real letter carries Cristina’s handwritten signature.

Santa’s favorite tradition

It is called Jólabókaflóð, the Christmas book flood. Books are given on Christmas Eve, and read that same night.

Santa approves. Nobody has ever had to restart a book.
